_contract: The Phase-C1 INSTANCE data the authorization assembler needs: which committed objects to read, which money figures to refuse a mis-priced session against, and what the session's stage conditions say. Every value here was a literal inside src/aadistill until 2026-09-08. Moving it out is what lets the core be reused by another experiment. AUTHORIZES NOTHING: this is configuration, not a grant.
_stage_id_meaning: Which PIPELINE STAGE this experiment belongs to, DECLARED by the maintainer rather than inferred from a name or from which code the pod happens to execute. C1 is Stage 1 -- projection and structural initialization. Its two arms are two Stage-1 initializations that differ in exactly one operator of DEPTH->FFN->RESIDUAL_WIDTH->ATTENTION, and the question it answers is which ATTENTION initialization to keep. The six 0.86M recovery probes it trains are the measuring INSTRUMENT for that question, not the subject: grouping the runs by the instrument would file an initialization experiment next to Stage-3 recovery work and lose what it is for. The PHASE is C, carried by experiment_id 'phase_c1'; the ATTEMPT is the run_id. Stage, phase and attempt are three dimensions and this field is only the first. Consumed by scripts/experiments/run_layout.py to place runs at logs/runs/stage-1/phase_c1/<run_id>/.

accepted_pricing._why_restated: so a mis-priced session is REFUSED rather than mirrored. A ceiling that only echoes its source is not an independent check, and this is the last place a mis-priced session can be stopped before a grant exists. Amended 2026-09-04 for the approved repricing to the secure L40S rate of $1.09/h; every minute assumption is unchanged. The superseded triple at $0.99/h was 13.7578 / 12.2070 / 13.4277.
accepted_pricing._cap_amendment: 2026-09-11: the PROJECT cumulative cap rose from 283.76 to 320.00 (+36.24) with the approved execution package below. AMENDED AGAIN 2026-09-17: 320.00 -> 370.00 (+50.00), on the maintainer decision closing the Phase-C2 preparation round. The per-attempt ceiling did NOT move and no minute assumption changed. The issuer refuses a grant naming any other cap, which is why this value lives here rather than being inferred from the ledger. AMENDED AGAIN 2026-09-28: 370.00 -> 400.00 (+30.00), on the maintainer decision funding the complete 3-arm x 3-seed formal C3. The per-session envelope moved in the same decision, 15.1475 -> 30.00; see execution_package._amendment_2026_09_28.
accepted_pricing._the_2026_09_17_raise_is_an_accounting_e: NOT a spend authorization and NOT permission to launch either C2 session. It is the project's cumulative accounting bound, which the C2 chain's ceilings must fit inside; each session still needs its own grant, readiness record, one-use authorization and bundle. The headroom is NOT transferable to C3, C4 or any unrelated experiment, and the C1 formal/engineering/package allowances below did NOT move.
accepted_pricing._why_this_experiments_config_owns_a_proj: historical: the cap was first stated with C1's approved package and derive_budget.py reads it from here (scripts/consolidate/derive_budget.py :: project_balance). It is a PROJECT fact living in one experiment's config, which is poor ownership; it is left in place because moving it would repoint every consumer during a round whose purpose is a governance chain, and a cap with two owners is worse than a cap with an awkward one.
accepted_pricing._floor_and_soft_stop_are_c1_instance: hard_ceiling_usd 15.1475, planning_floor_usd 13.4401 and soft_stop_usd 14.7841 are C1's OWN accepted session pricing, derived for C1's $1.09/h session and cross-checked against phase_c1_pricing.json by the grant issuer -- which refused a $30.00 value here with 'pricing ceiling $15.1475 != $30.0000'. They are NOT the package's per-session envelope. That envelope is execution_package.per_attempt_hard_ceiling_usd, raised to $30.00 on 2026-09-28, and it is what derive_budget.py reports. C1 is COMPLETE/GO so nothing will re-issue against this triple; every NEW formal session derives its own ceiling from live pricing at issuance.

execution_package._contract: The maintainer decision this experiment's attempts run under. INSTANCE POLICY, which is why it is configuration and not core: the core knows nothing about attempts, packages, dollars or retries. AUTHORIZES NOTHING BY ITSELF -- a launch still needs a grant, an authorization, a launch-bound readiness record and a bundle.
execution_package.approved_by: maintainer decision, 2026-09-11, after independent engineering review of 55bb324a..199711af
execution_package.limits_do_not_transfer: the engineering allowance, the per-session ceiling, the package total and the project cap bind SEPARATELY. An unspent engineering allowance does not raise the per-session ceiling, and the $0.6577 margin is for real accounting corrections, not spending. The attempt COUNT is no longer one of these limits -- see _attempts_amendment_2026_09_11b -- but the money is unchanged, and money is what now bounds how many sessions are possible.

attempt_counting.rule: invoking the formal launcher under a NEW one-use authorization is one formal SESSION. Sessions are still numbered, recorded and ledgered individually; what was withdrawn on 2026-09-11 is the CAP on how many there may be, not the counting.
attempt_counting.not_counted: read-only checks, code repair and GPU engineering validation before an authorization is issued.
attempt_counting.prospective_only: this governs THIS package. It does not rewrite the 2026-09-04 ruling, under which attempt 3 was not consumed because no provider resource was created, nor the counting attempts 10 and 11 ran under.
attempt_counting.no_hidden_retries: one provider-create call per DRAW, at most three draws per session, at most one billing resource at any instant, and every draw recorded with its own pod id, cost and watchdog. A redraw is not a hidden retry; an unrecorded one would be.

autonomous_formal_retry_requires_all_of: it can be CONFIRMED that no formal probe training has started

the failure is an ordinary infrastructure, setup or $0 pre-provider failure, and its cause is identified and handled -- for a provider transient, backing off and requesting another host IS the handling, and no repository change is required
a deterministic engineering error is not repeated unchanged: locate, fix minimally, verify, update the affected bindings, then retry
frozen science, the input contracts and the decision rule are unchanged
the previous resource is confirmed no longer billing
the remaining package balance funds the planned session plus evidence recovery and teardown
the new session uses a new run identity and a complete, valid one-use authorization chain
stop_and_report: formal probe training has STARTED and a failure follows -- peripheral engineering may be repaired and the SAME experiment resumed only where the existing protocol already supports it and state, identity and continuity verify; resume semantics are never invented, and model weights alone are not assumed sufficient
it cannot be confirmed whether training started -- absence of confirmation is not confirmation of absence
a real replay mismatch, a frozen-science conflict, or evidence whose provenance cannot be verified
any complete, valid GO / NO-GO / INCONCLUSIVE -- all three END this round's formal execution, and re-running a valid result for a better one is forbidden
budget, resource scope or a rerun that cannot preserve scientific validity
never: re-running a valid INCONCLUSIVE in pursuit of a GO
changing arms, seeds, recipe, battery, statistics or the behavioural vetoes
engineering_allowance_does_not_authorize: consuming the frozen confirmation battery for an endpoint
formal execution -- that comes from the $55.0000 formal allowance, and the two do not transfer
execution_package._attempts_amendment_2026_09_11b: The three-attempt cap and the one-provider-resource-per-invocation rule are WITHDRAWN, prospectively, by a maintainer decision of 2026-09-11 taken after attempt 11. Ordinary infrastructure failures, setup failures and $0 pre-provider refusals -- where it is CONFIRMED that no formal probe training has started -- are now diagnosed, handled and retried autonomously inside the remaining budget, with no package-level cap on the number of launcher invocations. Attempts 10 and 11 keep their records, costs, numbering and the authorization semantics they actually ran under; what is withdrawn is a future constraint, not a record.
what_still_binds: the money: $65.6523 formal, $10.0000 engineering, $75.6523 package -- amended 2026-10-02 for the complete A3 chain; these package allowances are what this document authorizes and they bind SEPARATELY. The package total is their sum, and it is still CHECKED separately at issuance: an amendment that raised one without the other would otherwise authorize a session the package cannot fund

the CURRENT project cumulative cap is deliberately not restated here. It was $320.0000 when this package was approved and has since been amended; its canonical owner is accepted_pricing.cumulative_cap_usd in this same file, which derive_budget reads. Do not read a current cap from this list -- restating it is exactly how one live file came to state two different current caps

$30.0000 per launcher SESSION as the ENVELOPE, covering every host draw inside it -- draws do not each get a ceiling. The envelope is not the grant: a session receives the ceiling DERIVED from live pricing at issuance, which must be <= this envelope
at most ONE BILLING resource at any instant, now enforced by SessionRunner.release_and_confirm rather than by making the redraw branch unreachable

secure L40S; no other GPU and no price chasing, but securePrice is re-queried LIVE immediately before each authorization and the session's ceiling is derived from it. $1.09/h is a historical observation, not a frozen bound -- a different live price is re-priced, not refused
every cost counts: a failure, a new run_id, a new pod or a new authorization resets nothing
the science: arms, seeds, recipe, battery, statistic and behavioural vetoes are frozen

acquisition.what_a_draw_is: replacing a host that never became usable -- cold, or no endpoint -- inside ONE session and inside its one ceiling. A draw is not an attempt and not a way to chase stock.
acquisition.why_create_attempts_stays_one: a create-attempt sleeps and asks the same market again. Draws replace an unusable host; that is the authorized mechanism, price chasing is not.
acquisition.between_batches: after a batch is exhausted, inspect the failure mode and supply before continuing. Low stock is a reason to back off at $0 and pick a better moment, not a proven cause -- one Medium success and one Low failure is not a finding, and nothing about it is written into src/aadistill.
acquisition.release_rule: a returncode, a null runtime, a failed query or a cleared local pod_id are NOT evidence that a resource stopped billing. Only the provider saying so is. If it cannot be confirmed, no further resource is created and the state is reconciled first.

execution_package.success_is: one complete, valid, fully evidenced C1 result. GO is not required: a valid NO-GO or INCONCLUSIVE ends the round just as much.
execution_package._engineering_allowance_amendment_2026_09: MAINTAINER DECISION 2026-09-27, in the packing-optimization v2 review: the GPU ENGINEERING allowance rises $6.00 -> $10.00, and the package total therefore $51.4425 -> $55.4425. ENGINEERING ONLY. `formal_allowance_usd` stays $45.4425, `per_attempt_hard_ceiling_usd` stays $15.1475 and `cumulative_cap_usd` stays $370.00 -- none of them moved and this transfers no money into formal C3, which remains NOT STARTED and separately unauthorized. The reason is arithmetic: engineering remaining had fallen to $0.6443, so granting a new campaign without this would have been granting a ceiling nothing could be spent under. The four limits still bind SEPARATELY.
execution_package._amendment_2026_09_28: MAINTAINER DECISION 2026-09-28, on the review of b937aebb, which stopped formal C3 for funding rather than reducing the science. Funding is declared not to be the limiting factor. PROSPECTIVE, current-only: project cumulative cap 370.00 -> 400.00; per-session hard ceiling 15.1475 -> 30.00 (an ENVELOPE, not an automatic grant); formal allowance 45.4425 -> 55.00; GPU engineering allowance unchanged at 10.00; package total 55.4425 -> 65.00, which is 55 + 10 by construction. Historical issued authorizations and historical run records are UNCHANGED. C3's own one-use authorization receives the ceiling derived from live securePrice immediately before issuance, and proceeds only if that derived ceiling <= 30.00 AND cumulative spend + derived ceiling <= 400.00 AND remaining formal allowance >= derived ceiling.

funds_formal_sessions_of._contract: Which experiments' formal sessions spend THIS package's formal allowance. Instance policy, which is why it is configuration: the deriver must not carry a hardcoded phase name, and it did -- `FORMAL_EXPERIMENT = "phase_c1"` -- so formal C3 sessions reached the project cumulative and never touched the $55.00 formal allowance they are funded from. A run whose own records state a `package_id` is attributed by that instead; this list is what covers runs predating that field, and historical authorizations are NOT rewritten to add one.
funds_formal_sessions_of.phase_c1: the package was approved for it on 2026-09-11
funds_formal_sessions_of.phase_c3: the 2026-09-28 amendment funds formal C3 from this allowance and makes `remaining formal allowance >= derived session ceiling` one of the three conditions a C3 authorization must satisfy. A session that must pass a formal-allowance gate is a session that spends the formal allowance.

execution_package._amendment_2026_10_02: MAINTAINER DECISION 2026-10-02, authorizing the COMPLETE A3 chain as ONE end-to-end experiment -- initialization, recovery, evaluation, aggregation, closeout -- rather than as a step-1/step-2 split needing intermediate approvals. PROSPECTIVE AND CURRENT-ONLY. formal allowance 55.0000 -> 65.6523 (+10.6523); package total 65.0000 -> 75.6523 (+10.6523, which is the same raise: the package total REMAINS formal + engineering by construction, because package.spent is derived as that same sum and a cap computed on a different basis from its spend is a cap nobody can reconcile); GPU engineering allowance UNCHANGED at 10.0000; per-session envelope UNCHANGED at 30.0000; project cumulative cap UNCHANGED at 400.0000, because the derived chain fits it with headroom. NO NEW SPENDABLE HEADROOM BEYOND THE FORMAL RAISE: A3 is charged to the formal book, the books do not transfer, and the unspent 1.9395 of engineering allowance was already authorized and cannot fund a formal probe. DERIVED, NOT CHOSEN: scripts/experiments/phase_c3/a3_pricing.py prices the full chain at a live L40S securePrice of 1.09/h as 5.8680 expected and 8.2525 hard over 450.82 minutes, on a 60 GB container disk derived from a 36.06 GiB peak local residency and a 6.664 GiB durable requirement. The amendment funds that ceiling plus ONE pre-science restart of 1.4506 -- the chain up to the first scientific probe, at hard rates, from the same component table -- because this decision also requires autonomous rerun of failed engineering and setup stages, and an allowance sized to exactly one flawless run cannot execute that instruction. Total funded on the formal book: 9.7031. Nothing else is added. THE HISTORICAL OVERSPEND STANDS AS FACT: attempt75 was issued against a formal allowance it exceeded by 0.9492, the authorization-gate defect that permitted it is recorded in logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c3/analyses/formal_allowance_audit.json, and nothing here rewrites attempt75, its grant, its authorization or its closeout into compliance. Raising a forward-looking allowance is not retroactive permission, and the 55.9492 already spent is still 55.9492.
execution_package._issuance_conditions_superseded_2026_10_: The 2026-09-28 amendment listed THREE issuance conditions: derived ceiling <= envelope, cumulative + derived <= project cap, and remaining formal allowance >= derived ceiling. There are FOUR: the PACKAGE TOTAL binds too. It looked implied because it equals formal + engineering, and that is exactly why nothing evaluated it -- an identity is not a check, and a future amendment that moved one side would break it silently. It is now the fourth condition in formal_pricing.evaluate_limits, which RAISES on a missing envelope rather than treating an absent limit as a satisfied one. The historical text of the 2026-09-28 amendment is left exactly as it was decided.

stage_conditions.replay: stop before any recovery training on a parent or incumbent digest mismatch; preserve the evidence and treat it as the attempt's result
stage_conditions.device_handoff: stop before recovery if the card is not released
stage_conditions.training: all six trainings must complete before any evaluation; a training failure is C1_INCOMPLETE, not a partial confirmation experiment
stage_conditions.generation_admission: no probe is scored unless the generation protocol observed from its own raw summaries is comparable to the attested C1 protocol
stage_conditions.decision: stage I requires six complete admitted and scored probes
stage_conditions.retry: THIS authorization funds exactly ONE launcher session. Inside that session the launcher may take up to the approved number of acquisition draws, replacing a host that was created and never became usable; at most ONE resource may be billing at any instant, enforced by SessionRunner.release_and_confirm, and every draw shares this session's single ceiling. A FURTHER session needs a new grant, a new launch-bound readiness record, a new authorization and a new bundle -- see execution_package for when that is permitted without a further maintainer decision.

one_use: ONE grant, ONE issuance, ONE launcher session. Within the session, acquisition draws are bounded by execution_package.acquisition and never exceed one BILLING resource at a time. A failure is this session's result; a new session always uses a complete new one-use chain and never reuses a consumed one.
_superseded_wording_note: Until 2026-09-11 these two fields read 'no replacement pod' and 'ONE provider resource'. That was the rule attempts 1-12 ran under and it is preserved in their issued authorizations, which are not rewritten. It stopped describing the generation source when the package permitted bounded acquisition draws, and an authorization that contradicts the package it is issued under is a governance defect even when nothing reads the prose.
